To resolve the CI failure (`ARCH-4`), the `OrderPlaced` event payload now provides both the new property names (`amountCents`, `createdAt`) and retains the legacy property names (`totalCents`, `placedAt`) for backward compatibility with downstream consumers (`analytics-ingest` and `billing-service`).

### Changes
- [events.ts](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L62):
  - Updated [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L28) interface to include `createdAt` alongside legacy `placedAt`, and `amountCents` alongside legacy `totalCents`.
  - Updated [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/src/core/events.ts#L46-L62) factory function to populate both pairs of fields (`createdAt` and `placedAt` from `order.placedAt`; `amountCents` and `totalCents` from `totalCents(order)`).
- [app.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/test/app.test.ts#L21-L34): Updated integration test assertions for `OrderPlaced` to include both sets of fields.
- [adapters.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w4/r/test/adapters.test.ts#L46-L55): Added assertions verifying that both `amountCents` / `totalCents` and `createdAt` / `placedAt` are serialized in Kafka records.

- `npm test`: All 39 tests passed.
- `npm run typecheck`: Passed with zero type errors.
- `npm run arch`: All architecture rules satisfied.
